topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I walked into my favorite little spot, the one with the warm lighting and even warmer service, only to find a sign taped to the hostess stand. "Last Day of Service." The words seemed out of place, like a typo. I greeted Maria, the hostess, and she nodded with a small, knowing smile. "I heard," I replied, taking in the familiar scents of garlic and fresh bread. I slid into my usual booth, traced the patterns on the tablecloth, and ordered my go-to meal. As I savored each bite, I let the place soak in, committing every detail to memory. It was a good meal, a final toast to a cherished haunt.
